    .cylinder(27.1, 81.9)
    .faces("<Z")

    .faces(">Z")

    .faces(">Z")
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polarArray(60.8, 0, 360, 6)
    .hole(23.6)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 14.9), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(2.7, 46.8)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 35.6), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(38.7, 29.7)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(32.2)
)
show_object(result)
